title: A principal open defined by a nonzerodivisor is dense
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring [def-pc-scheme] and let $a\in A$ be a non-zero-divisor. Then the principal open $D(a)\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ is topologically dense.
